notes: Lead: CTO (Mina Alvarez) & Head of Platform (Liam O'Connor). Use-case: VSCode + JetBrains extension that streams token-by-token for completions and inline copilots. Peak developer hours: 09:00-11:30 PST and 14:00-16:00 CET — need predictable throughput for those windows. Requirements summary: dedicated capacity for deterministic tail latency (<80ms median token latency for completion), burst policy to handle internal hack days (~3x baseline QPS for 4 hours), model pinning (want to pin to Llama-3-70B quantized v1 then optionally fallback to an L2 small variant), per-route routing (IDE telem vs CI batch jobs), KV/prefix cache reuse across user sessions to cut token costs. Security: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2, KMS integration for customer keys, audit logs retained 1 year, optional EU residency for EU dev teams. Cost sensitivity: engineering-led procurement, wants predictable monthly committed spend vs pay-as-you-go. Quote from CTO: "We need completions to feel instantaneous in the IDE — streaming tokens at low latency is table stakes. If Dedicated can guarantee steady throughput during our 9-11 spikes, we're comfortable committing." Notes from SE: running internal baseline shows 12k requests/min during peak on current in-house infra; ask Redwood for CPU/GPU sizing guidance for 150 concurrent active dev sessions. POC success criteria: 95th p50/p95 latency targets met, cost per session below current infra by >=20%, smooth failover to fallback model w/o degraded editor UX.
